TERMINAL · BUILD FROM SOURCE

BEFORE THE FIRST FLAKE

A few good
questions.

✳
Is Nightfall really free?+

Yes. You can build and run it from the source. There’s no account, license key, or subscription. Prebuilt, signed installers aren’t available yet.

Will it get in the way of my work?+

The desktop snow is click-through. Use the settings window or tray menu to adjust or stop it whenever you like.

Where does it work?+

The Rust/Tauri app targets macOS and Arch Linux with Hyprland. Hyprland uses a native layer-shell overlay. macOS uses transparent Tauri windows. The app is in development; target-desktop verification is still needed.

How lightweight is it?+

There’s no bundled Chromium. The Rust simulation caps flakes at 900 per screen, with 30 fps by default and an optional 60 fps mode. Exact memory use and battery impact depend on your desktop; we don’t have benchmark numbers to promise.

Does it need an internet connection?+

Only to install the build dependencies. The desktop app runs locally and doesn’t load remote fonts, analytics, or weather services.
